title: Credit and Collections Guideline: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Low-Balance Disconnection and Reconnection
content:
**Disconnection.** A PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) meter is disconnected when the prepaid balance is at or below the tier's disconnect balance, but only inside a permitted window: between the tier's earliest and latest disconnect times of day, local time; never on a Saturday or Sunday unless the tier allows weekend disconnections; never on a cooperative holiday unless the tier allows holiday disconnections; never on a Friday after the tier's Friday cutoff; and, where the weather hold applies on the tier, never on a day for which the system has recorded a weather-hold alert because the forecast low is at or below the tier's cold-hold temperature or the forecast high is at or above its heat-hold temperature.

**Warning lead time.** Disconnection may be performed only after the tier's warning lead time has elapsed since the disconnect warning alert was sent. Hours are counted as full elapsed 60-minute periods from the timestamp of the most recent disconnect warning alert on that prepay account; once the full lead time has elapsed the condition is met.

**Waiting for a window.** A balance that reaches the threshold outside a window waits for the next permitted window.

**Reconnection.** The meter is reconnected remotely, at any hour and on any day, as soon as a payment brings the prepaid balance to the tier's reconnect balance or more; the tier's reconnect fee applies.

**Counseling referral.** When the low-balance disconnections of the prepay account in the 30 days ending on the current date, inclusive, counted by the disconnected alerts sent in that period, reach the tier's referral count, a counseling referral alert is sent and the member is offered an energy counseling call; the referral does not stop the program.

### Figures by tier

| Tier | Disconnect at or below | Reconnect at or above | Weather hold applies | Warning lead time (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 0.00 | 10.00 | yes | 24 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 0.00 | 10.00 | yes | 24 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 0.00 | 10.00 | yes | 24 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 0.00 | 20.00 | yes | 24 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 0.00 | 10.00 | no | 24 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | -25.00 | 50.00 | no | 48 |

### Condition, judgement, result (hypothetical times, PrePay Power Residential with a 24-hour lead time)

| Most recent disconnect warning | Moment considered | Full hours elapsed | Lead-time condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuesday 10:20 | Wednesday 10:19 | 23 | not met |
| Tuesday 10:20 | Wednesday 10:20 | 24 | met |
| Tuesday 10:20 | Wednesday 16:00 | 29 | met, but 16:00 lies outside the permitted window, so the disconnection waits |

On PrePay Power Small Commercial, whose lead time is 48 hours, the same Tuesday 10:20 warning meets the lead-time condition on Thursday at 10:20.

### Reconnection case (hypothetical)

A meter on PrePay Power Seasonal is disconnected at a balance of -3.00. A payment on Sunday evening brings the balance to 21.00, at or above the reconnect balance of 20.00 for that tier: the meter is reconnected then, Sunday and evening hours notwithstanding.
